Thank you for your enquiry.  However, you have raised this on the incorrect PT code. 

PT0077 is for distribution to raise queries. This needs raising on a Pt0030
Please re-raise using the right process PT code.  
We are archiving this message so please do not respond.

Hi, our customer lives at the address associated with this meter, but they insist that the meter is their neighbour's. We are supplying non-smart meter also registered at this property and have confirmed the MSN. Can you ask your customer to confirm their address and send D381 if necessary? Thanks
